# Test archives

- `backpack.7z`: a 7 Days to Die mod with `ModInfo.xml` at the archive root,
  created with py7zr for these tests.
- `rar3-solid.rar`, `rar5-solid.rar`: solid RAR archives with two text files
  (`stest1.txt`, `stest2.txt`), taken from the test files of the
  [rarfile](https://github.com/markokr/rarfile) project (ISC license), because
  RAR archives cannot be created with free tools.
